Open this listingView details

The Chicago Department of Family and Support Services activates its Community Service Centers and Senior Centers as warming centers during extreme cold weather. These locations provide safe refuge and relief for all residents when temperatures drop to 32 degrees or below.

Check before you go. Activated when temperatures are expected to be 32 degrees or below. Community Service Centers are open Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and Senior Centers are open Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
